title: Capillary-selective vasodilation through myosin inhibition halts ischaemic cascades
title_zh: 通过肌动蛋白抑制实现选择性毛细血管扩张，阻止缺血级联反应
abstract: In acute myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury, capillary no-reflow denotes that capillary blood flow is still blocked despite successful arterial reperfusion. This is associated with substantially increased mortality and reinfarction risk; nevertheless, no targeted therapy exists so far1,2. Because capillary no-reflow is driven by smooth muscle myosin-mediated hypercontraction of capillary pericytes, we developed R(+)2501, a myosin-specific and capillary-selective vasodilator. In reperfused animal models of acute myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury, direct in vivo imaging showed that R(+)2501 rapidly restored capillary flow, an effect sustained even after rapid drug clearance. Ex vivo experiments confirmed reversal of pericyte constriction directly. Restoration of capillary blood flow, together with clearance of trapped neutrophils, linked resolution of capillary no-reflow to attenuation of an early driver of reperfusion injury. R(+)2501 enhanced capillary perfusion while preserving coronary autoregulation and systemic haemodynamics, and markedly improved survival during acute reperfusion. We further found that acute myocardial infarction induced renal capillary no-reflow, which was reversed by R(+)2501, suggesting that capillary no-reflow contributes to the pathophysiology of cardiorenal syndrome type I. These findings establish pericyte-targeted smooth muscle myosin inhibition as a therapeutic strategy to restore microvascular perfusion and halt the ischaemic cascade across organs, while defining a specific physiological role for capillaries and pericytes in circulatory regulation. R(+)2501 reverses capillary no-reflow by relaxing pericytes, restoring microvascular perfusion and improving survival in animal models of myocardial infarction and acute kidney injury.
abstract_zh: 在急性心肌梗死和急性肾损伤中，毛细血管无灌注是指尽管动脉再灌注成功，但毛细血管血流仍被阻塞。这与显著增加的死亡率和再梗风险相关；然而，迄今为止尚无针对性治疗1,2。由于毛细血管无灌注是由平滑肌肌动蛋白介导的毛细血管周细胞超痉挛引起的，研究人员开发了R(+)2501，一种特异性针对毛细血管的肌动蛋白抑制剂。在急性心肌梗死和急性肾损伤的再灌注动物模型中，体内直接成像显示R(+)2501迅速恢复了毛细血管血流，且在药物快速清除后效果仍持续。体外实验证实了直接逆转周细胞痉挛。恢复毛细血管血流，以及清除被困中性粒细胞，将缺血无灌注的解决与再灌注损伤早期驱动因素的缓解联系起来。R(+)2501增强了毛细血管灌注，同时保留了冠状动脉自主调节和体循环动力学，并在急性再灌注中显著提高了存活率。此外，研究人员还发现，急性心肌梗死诱导肾脏毛细血管无灌注，且可被R(+)2501逆转，这表明毛细血管无灌注有助于I型心肾综合征的病理生理机制。这些发现确立了以毛细血管周细胞为靶点的平滑肌肌动蛋白抑制作为恢复微血管灌注和阻止全身缺血级联反应的治疗策略，并定义了毛细血管和周细胞在循环调节中特定的生理作用。R(+)2501通过放松周细胞、恢复微血管灌注并改善动物模型中心肌梗死和急性肾损伤的存活率来逆转毛细血管无灌注。
